_help: One entry per photoset added to the gallery, newest first, written by hand when a set goes up. from and to are its first and last frame numbers (photography-files.json), date the day it was added, place where it was taken (it ends the line "28 new photographs from <place>."). generate_photo_feed.py builds feed-photos.xml from this and copies the newest set into KR_NEW_PHOTOS in js/shared-components.js, which marks those frames New in the gallery and on the homepage.
